Stable.Changelog:
Added:
Shift+0 shortcut for vorticity display mode
Changed:
Allow SEED to grow on SPNG and drain water from it
Adjust ACID+BASE = SLTW reaction to make it easier to trigger
Reduce lag in water equalization
Reorganize intro text and add more shortcuts
Fixed:
Fix high vorticity values producing self-sustaining airflows in thin tubes
Fix rendering framerate cap not loading from preferences
Fix crashes when loading saves with specific corrupted data
Fix multiple crashes triggered by setting specific properties on some elements via Lua
Fix multiple crashes when using large or unexpected arguments to some Lua functions
Fix crash when typing "0b" into the PROP tool on MacOS

Beta.Changelog:
Added:
New element: BASE. Corrosive liquid, neutralizes ACID
New element: SEED. Grows into a tree when planted and watered
Add creation reactions for AMTR, PTNM, and LITH
Add optional heat conduction to pipes
Add PSTN .tmp3 flags for cancelling movement when the full movement can't be performed
Add multiple new air sim settings, including ambient air pressure and velocity
Add basic search to stamp browser
Add dynamic heat display (Shift+6)
Add binary support to PROP tool
Add fps and draw cap options in settings
Add checkerboard mode for grid tool - sim.gridCheckerboard(1)
Changed:
FOG/RIME can absorb gas to become acidic, condense to acid
LN2 now can condense on strong GLAS when ambient temperature is low enough
Cap velocity and pressure in some reactions
Preserve deco in pipe, as long as the pipe wasn't already decorated
Minor fixes to various reactions
Update / improve many element descriptions
Restrict some Lua API functionality to certain events, some scripts need to be fixed and updated
Fixed:
Fix infinite air heat near the boundary
Fix gaseous elements trending down and right
Fix ambient heat not convecting from the right or bottom edges
Fix SOAP movement in loop edge mode
Fix crash when using !get on float types

MessageOfTheDay: Use the report button to report stolen saves, always include the original id
